input.text: Staff must record the reason and the approver for every pricing exception in the loan file.
sources: Record the reason and the approver for every pricing exception in the loan file.

input.text: A branch manager can lower a loan rate by no more than 0.25% as an exception.
sources: A branch manager can lower a loan rate by no more than 0.25% as an exception.

input.text: A regional manager may approve a rate exception as large as 0.50%.
sources: A regional manager can approve a rate exception as large as 0.50%.

input.text: Refer an account for charge-off once it has been negative for 45 days.
sources: Refer an account for charge-off once it has been negative for 45 days.

input.text: The records custodian must approve the destruction of any records in writing.
